comparisons.name: finder-search-empty-light
comparisons.description: The empty path bar at the bottom of the Finder Search window, Aqua: the two separator rows and the fill. The last point of the 25 pt bar is outside the crop (the window's edge highlight covers it). No text, so no masked variant.

comparisons.name: finder-search-empty-dark
comparisons.description: The empty path bar at the bottom of the Finder Search window, Dark Aqua: the two separator rows and the fill. The last point of the 25 pt bar is outside the crop (the dark window's inner border covers it). No text, so no masked variant.

comparisons.name: populated-light
comparisons.description: A path of three components, Aqua: where the icons and the chevrons fall, and that the last component draws no chevron. Every captured Finder path bar is empty, so these are pixel checks of the stated layout [provisional], not a comparison with a screenshot.
